# Set the Pole <span class="script">立極</span>

<p class="lens-meta"><code class="lens-code">LIJI</code> · Chinese — 名家, 宋明理學, and the classics · <strong>Enforced — owns a gate</strong></p>

## The failure it names

judging something without ever declaring the standard judged against

## What it does

an evaluative claim requires a `judged_by` edge to a Criterion

## Enforced gates

These block a citation packet deterministically — no model in the loop:

- `PEIR-CRITERION-UNDECLARED`

## Worked example

"…sits in a directory commonly used to stage malware" calls a path suspicious without ever stating the standard of suspicion, so the reader cannot tell whether %TEMP% qualifies by frequency, by policy, or by the author's intuition.

## Sources

- 周敦頤《太極圖說》: 聖人定之以中正仁義而主靜，立人極焉
